_example: This is an example of what an add-on entry looks like. It is not installed and has no skill file yet. /growth module add creates the real one.
name: CV analyser
does: Reads your CV and says what to change first, with a score.
input: Your CV as a PDF or pasted text

abilities.label: Score your CV and say what to change first
abilities.reads: your CV as a PDF or pasted text

adds.text: A score out of 100 for your CV
adds.why: The file ends every read with a number; the built-in read gives notes only.

strengthens.text: Goes further than the built-in CV read
strengthens.why: The file lists 12 checks; the built-in checklist has 6.
